environment.description: Node.js 18 Apollo Server v4 deployed on AWS ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer. Single task instance with in-memory node-cache. JWT signing key stored in environment variable, rotated manually every 90 days. No request-level cache isolation. ALB forwards all traffic on port 4000 with no additional filtering. ECS task role has read access to Secrets Manager for DB credentials only.

config.auth: JWT HS256 with static signing key
